issues.summary: In _gen_ops_cached the second manifest_arch assignment unconditionally overwrites the '103a' value, so SM103 gets manifest_arch '100' and arch-conditional kernel skipping breaks; collapse into a single if/else chain.
`VERSION_GREATER "13.4"` is strict, so CUDA 13.4 itself (which introduces Rubin/sm_107) does not enable the Rubin/10.7 archs; use `VERSION_GREATER "13.3"` or `VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "13.4"`.
